vocabulary.definition: 一次施放或一次攻击能对多个敌方单位造成伤害
移除目标身上可被弱驱散的效果
降低目标护甲
让普通攻击附带额外效果：减甲、减速、减疗、烧蓝、额外伤害、中毒、降低属性等；有概率触发或只强化下一次攻击也算。单纯提高攻击力、攻速，以及吸血、暴击、分裂弹射归各自词条
跟着单位持续影响周围单位；对友军或敌方都算，并记作用对象；固定在地上的区域归场地魔法
说明明确写打断持续施法；眩晕、沉默等已有控制不重复记
技能或物品用一次消耗一点；只决定数值或层数的不算
攻击伤害波及周围单位
攻击造成额外倍数伤害；有概率触发或强化下一次攻击都算
处于减益免疫（技能免疫）时，只有能穿透减益免疫的效果才对其生效（如碎颅锤的重击可以眩晕开了黑皇杖的单位）
拉、推、交换、投掷其他单位（如动人之舐、移形换位）
提供额外金钱或经验；只是正常赏金不算
目标低于生命阈值时直接杀死
飞行移动，能越过地形
嘲讽、恐惧、催眠等强制目标攻击或移动；夺取控制权不在此类（归召唤物）
提供目标或区域的视野
降低或禁止目标的任何形式生命恢复，含属性回复；提升生命上限的效果不受影响
恢复生命值（治疗、生命恢复），含属性生命恢复（如治疗指环+4.5）
使自身、队友、召唤物或复制体隐身
暂时无法被伤害或无法被指向
降低目标魔抗，或让目标受到更多魔法或技能伤害
阻止目标闪烁、传送或离开范围；只是不能走的归定身
攻击无视闪避（必中）
使隐身单位显形，不等于持续真视
闪烁、冲刺、跳跃、传送等主动改变自身位置
目标无法施放技能（仍可攻击、使用物品）
降低移动速度或攻击速度
使目标无法行动和施法的硬控（含小眩晕）
召唤有血量的单位（可控或不可控都算），以及夺取已有单位的控制权；按受攻击次数计算的单位和死亡守卫不算
可看见隐身单位

objects.subject: drow_ranger_frost_arrows
objects.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续%abilityduration%秒。
objects.description_en: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。

scepter.zh: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。
scepter.en: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

objects.subject: drow_ranger_wave_of_silence
objects.description_zh: 释放一阵狂风，沉默敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。
objects.description_en: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

objects.subject: drow_ranger_multishot
objects.description_zh: 持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多%abilitychanneltime%秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + %arrow_range_base%的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
objects.description_en: CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + %arrow_range_base%. Lasts up to %abilitychanneltime% seconds.Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
notes_zh: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。

objects.subject: drow_ranger_glacier
objects.description_zh: 卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。
objects.description_en: Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

objects.subject: drow_ranger_marksmanship
objects.description_zh: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果%disable_range%范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
objects.description_en: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within %disable_range% range.
notes_zh: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。

objects.subject: earthshaker_fissure
objects.description_zh: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
objects.description_en: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
notes_zh: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。

shard.zh: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。
shard.en: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.

objects.subject: earthshaker_enchant_totem
objects.description_zh: 强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和%bonus_attack_range%攻击距离加成。
objects.description_en: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have %bonus_attack_range% bonus attack range on the next attack.
notes_zh: 攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。

scepter.zh: 强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。
scepter.en: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

objects.subject: earthshaker_aftershock
objects.description_zh: 撼地者施放技能时会引起脚下的大地震动，眩晕附近的敌方单位并造成额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
notes_zh: 使用物品不会触发余震。

objects.subject: earthshaker_echo_slam
objects.description_zh: 穿过地面的冲击波，伤害敌方单位。每个受到攻击的敌人都会引起伤害附近单位的反射波。英雄本体将引起两次反射。
objects.description_en: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.

objects.subject: earthshaker_slugger
objects.description_zh: 利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。
objects.description_en: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.

objects.subject: juggernaut_blade_fury
objects.description_zh: 舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得减益免疫状态，魔法抗性提升%immunity_resist%%%，并且每%blade_fury_damage_tick%秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。
objects.description_en: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with %immunity_resist%%% magic resistance and dealing damage every %blade_fury_damage_tick%s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
notes_zh: 剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。
主宰在施放剑刃风暴的过程中依然可以进行物理攻击。但是只有不受剑刃风暴伤害的单位，如守卫和建筑才会受到这些物理伤害。

objects.subject: juggernaut_healing_ward
objects.description_zh: 召唤一个治疗守卫，按周围友军单位最大生命值的一定比例治疗他们。治疗守卫可以移动，移动速度为%healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip%。持续%abilityduration%秒。
objects.description_en: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at %healing_ward_movespeed_tooltip% movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
notes_zh: 可以控制治疗守卫。
多个治疗守卫的效果不会叠加。

shard.zh: 提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。

objects.subject: juggernaut_blade_dance
objects.description_zh: 主宰有一定概率在攻击时触发致命一击。
objects.description_en: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

objects.subject: juggernaut_omni_slash
objects.description_zh:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

驱散类型：弱驱散
objects.description_en:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 无敌斩期间可以使用物品。

objects.subject: mirana_starfall
objects.description_zh: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。%starfall_secondary_radius%范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
objects.description_en: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a %starfall_secondary_radius% radius will be struck a second time.
notes_zh: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。

objects.subject: mirana_arrow
objects.description_zh: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短%arrow_min_stun%秒，最长可达%arrow_max_stun%秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多%arrow_bonus_damage%点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
objects.description_en: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from %arrow_min_stun% to %arrow_max_stun% seconds, with bonus damage up to %arrow_bonus_damage% added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
notes_zh: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。

scepter.zh: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。
scepter.en: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

objects.subject: mirana_leap
objects.description_zh: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。速度加成持续%leap_bonus_duration%秒。
objects.description_en: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts %leap_bonus_duration% seconds.

objects.subject: mirana_celestial_quiver
objects.description_zh: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。
objects.description_en: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.

shard.zh: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得%quiver_restore%点临时能量。
shard.en: Grants %quiver_restore% temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.

objects.subject: mirana_invis
objects.description_zh: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入隐身状态。米拉娜在持续时间内获得伤害输出加成。只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入隐身。
objects.description_en: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位会自动停止攻击敌人。

objects.subject: nevermore_shadowraze1
objects.description_zh: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
objects.description_en: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
notes_zh: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。

shard.zh: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少%cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的%movement_speed_debuff%%%移动速度减缓的负面效果。
shard.en: Cooldown reduced by %cooldown_reduction_on_hero_hit%s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking %movement_speed_debuff%%% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.

objects.subject: nevermore_dark_lord
objects.description_zh: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。
objects.description_en: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
notes_zh: 与其他降低护甲的技能和光环完全叠加。

objects.subject: nevermore_requiem
objects.description_zh: 影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
objects.description_en: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。

scepter.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。
scepter.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

objects.subject: nevermore_necromastery
objects.description_zh: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得%necromastery_damage_per_soul%点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得%souls_per_hero_kill%个灵魂。影魔死亡时%soul_release_tooltip%%%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
objects.description_en: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining %necromastery_damage_per_soul% bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant %souls_per_hero_kill% souls. On death, he releases %soul_release_tooltip%%% of them from bondage.
notes_zh: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

objects.subject: morphling_waveform
objects.description_zh: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。
objects.description_en: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.

objects.subject: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
objects.description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
objects.description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
